snippet.title: Road To Fame PC Game by IncaGold
snippet.description:
Bored with illegal races? Road To Fame is a new
colour on the palette. The basis is the same: take
a cheap or over-used car and win as many races
as you can. From the money you have made this
way you buy tunings or maybe a new, faster car.
Here you can do everything your carrier is in no
one´s but your hands!
